abstract: We give a counterexample to S. Novikov's 1982 conjecture that every Riemannian $2$-sphere contains a closed embedded curve of curvature $c$ for every $c>0$.
hook: A 2-sphere exists that lacks closed curves of some curvature, refuting Novikov's 1982 conjecture.
summary: Novikov conjectured that every curved 2-sphere has a simple closed curve of any prescribed curvature, which describes the path of a charged particle in a magnetic field. The author constructs a counterexample. The abstract gives no detail on the construction, so how general the failure is remains unclear.
title: Non-existence of closed embedded magnetic geodesics
